ppo_scope: Real PPO weights available, but saved traces lack full native observation/state/command. Direct parameter/observation derivatives possible at declared 17-D inputs; physical state mixed derivatives require a valid full native state/reference/command anchor and differentiable observation/support map. No such complete logged anchor is directly stored.
incompatibilities: Both learned actor families act on one input of a 3-state servo; the newer 6-state dual-actuator probe has no corresponding trained checkpoint.
PPO 17-D input is not six-state input: z is reference state, not a second actuator subsystem.
Older complete trace is real learned neural behavior but its training is not PPO; cannot relabel it.
PPO support map can dominate physical feedback and is piecewise/non-smooth at root/active-set changes; actor-only partial derivatives are not the full executed feedback derivative.
No saved complete old PPO batch supports actual advantage/ratio gradient replay.
Mean-controller derivatives have zero log_std column; stochastic policy gradients and deterministic derivatives differ.

derivative_requirements.older_trace_state_alignment: Stored state is posttransition; prepend initial_state and shift states by one. All 100x8 physical state/command/action anchor triples available without any integration.

root_selected_route: Genuine PPO native replay completed under separate frozen protocol; use reconstructed native PPO anchors, do not substitute the older non-PPO trace.
most_supported_combo_from_already_saved_: 2026-10-15 formal seed11/joint checkpoint + full trace for real neural action/mixed-state derivatives on native 3-state plant; explicitly not PPO

native_mpc_actor_dependency.objective: analytic response(z,c,eta,raw_design); does not depend on actor theta or actual x
native_mpc_actor_dependency.reference_reset: z is persistent and not reset to actual x at macro boundaries
native_mpc_actor_dependency.implication: Nonzero task demand for a neural feedback Jacobian requires an explicitly added theta-dependent response/robust-readout interface; separate gain derivatives are not the existing MPC gradient.

replay_feasibility_audit.important: Short must be initialized at length256, not truncated from long, because initialization RNG consumption differs with goal-array length.

completed_replay_reference.identity: Newly simulated fixed evaluation records matched against old metrics, not originally saved observations and not PPO training batch.
